results.title: Age Pension and deeming rates increases 20 September 2026
results.description:
# Age Pension and deeming rates increases 20 September 2026
### **Age Pension Rates from 20 September 2026**
The 20 September 2026 age pension increases will see singles on a full Age Pension set to receive an increase of $36.80 per fortnight ($956.80 per year) while a couple combined will receive an additional $55.60 per fortnight ($1,445.60 per year).

|  |  |  |  |
|-|-|-|-|
| **Per fortnight** | **Single** | **Couple each** | **Couple combined** |
| Maximum basic rate | $1,135.40 | $855.90 | $1,711.80 |
| Maximum Pension Supplement | $88.20 | $66.50 | $133.00 |
| Energy Supplement | $14.10 | $10.60 | $21.20 |
| **Total** | **$1,237.70** | **$933.00** | **$1,866.00** |
| **Increase per fortnight** | $36.80 | $27.80 | $55.60 |
| **Increase per year** | $956.80 | $722.80 | $1,445.60 |

### **Deeming rates from 20 September 2026**
For all financial assets exceeding the threshold, the rate has risen by 0.5 per cent to 3.75 per cent.

|  |  |  |
|-|-|-|
| First $66,800 (single) / $110,600 (couple) | 1.75% | 1.25% |
| Assets above the threshold | 3.75% | 3.25% |

### **Age Pension Asset Test limits**
|  |  |
|-|-|
| Homeowner (Single) | Non-Homeowner (Single) |
| $745,750 (Increase of $12,250) | $1,012,750 (Increase of $12,250) |
| Homeowner (Couple) | Non-Homeowner (Couple) |
| $1,121,000 (Increase of $18,500) | $1,388,000 (Increase of $18,500) |

### **Age Pension Income Limits**
|  |  |
|-|-|
| Single |
| $2,701.40 (Increase of $73.60) per fortnight | $70,236.40 (Increase of $1913.60) per year |
| $4,128.00 (Increase of $111.20) per fortnight | $107,328 (Increase of $2891.20) per year |
